item.question: In what ways do imagined story continuations complement existing feature engineering techniques?
item.answer: Imagined story continuations complement existing feature engineering techniques by providing additional dimensions—expectations, uncertainty, and surprise—that enhance explanatory power. These new features offer insights into how audiences might react based on their beliefs about future developments in a narrative.
